panels.description: Estimated Yield: percentage of samples where max|PE| <= pe_setting (within tolerance).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE
        GREATEST(
          ABS(pe_1),
          ABS(pe_2),
          ABS(pe_3),
          ABS(pe_4),
          ABS(pe_5),
          ABS(pe_6)
        ) <= pe_setting
    ) / NULLIF(
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
          pe_1 IS NOT NULL
      ),
      0
    ),
    1
  ) AS value
FROM
  public.ldi_data
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
  AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
  AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: Availability

panels.description: Average real Cpk across machines with JE data in the selected filters. Uses je_1 through je_4 and assumes symmetric +/- je_setting limits. Machines with zero variation are excluded because Cpk is undefined.

targets.rawSql:
WITH je_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.je_setting, j.je
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.je_1),(d.je_2),(d.je_3),(d.je_4)) j(je)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND j.je IS NOT NULL
    AND d.je_setting > 0
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    eqp_id,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(je) AS mean_je,
    STDDEV_SAMP(je) AS sigma,
    AVG(je_setting) AS lim
  FROM je_samples
  GROUP BY eqp_id
), cpk AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(
      (lim - mean_je) / NULLIF(3 * sigma, 0),
      (mean_je + lim) / NULLIF(3 * sigma, 0)
    ) AS value
  FROM stats
  WHERE sample_count >= 2
    AND sigma > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value
FROM cpk;

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)

)

panels.description: Average MAX|PE| divided by the PE limit stored on each record. This normalized scale allows machines with different PE limits to be compared fairly.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_rows AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      ABS(pe_1),
      ABS(pe_2),
      ABS(pe_3),
      ABS(pe_4),
      ABS(pe_5),
      ABS(pe_6)
    ) AS max_error,
    pe_setting
  FROM
    public.ldi_data
  WHERE
    factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
    AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
    AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
    AND pe_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND pe_setting > 0
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(100.0 * max_error / pe_setting) :: NUMERIC, 1) AS PE
FROM
  pe_rows

WITH je_rows AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      ABS(je_1),
      ABS(je_2),
      ABS(je_3),
      ABS(je_4)
    ) AS max_error,
    je_setting
  FROM
    public.ldi_data
  WHERE
    factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
    AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
    AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
    AND je_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND je_setting > 0
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(100.0 * max_error / je_setting) :: NUMERIC, 1) AS JE
FROM
  je_rows

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND m.alarm_type = 'A')::NUMERIC AS "A",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND m.alarm_type = 'W')::NUMERIC AS "W",

panels.title: Alarm Summary

panels.description: Calculated from total_time / total_board. Colors are derived from the current 439 five-minute database cells: green below P75 (0.099 s), amber from P75 to P95 (0.099-0.265 s), and red at or above P95 (0.265 s). Hover for machine, timestamp, and cycle time; click a populated cell to open a +/-5 minute engineering drilldown.

targets.rawSql:
WITH BaseStats AS (
  SELECT 
    eqp_id, 
    AVG(total_time) AS overall_avg, 
    COALESCE(NULLIF(STDDEV(total_time), 0), 1) AS overall_stddev
  FROM public.ldi_data 
  WHERE "time" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' 
    AND total_time > 0 
    AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY eqp_id 
),
BucketStats AS (
  SELECT 
    time_bucket('5 minutes', d."time") AS time, 
    d.eqp_id, 
    AVG(d.total_time) AS bucket_avg
  FROM public.ldi_data d 
  WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) 
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
    AND d.log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(d."time") 
    AND d.total_time > 0 
  GROUP BY 1, 2 
)
SELECT 
  bk.time, 
  bk.eqp_id AS metric, 
  CASE 
    WHEN ((bk.bucket_avg - b.overall_avg) / b.overall_stddev) <= -2.5 THEN 1
    WHEN ((bk.bucket_avg - b.overall_avg) / b.overall_stddev) <= -1.5 THEN 2
    WHEN ((bk.bucket_avg - b.overall_avg) / b.overall_stddev) >= 2.5 THEN 5
    WHEN ((bk.bucket_avg - b.overall_avg) / b.overall_stddev) >= 1.5 THEN 4
    ELSE 3
  END AS value 
FROM BucketStats bk 
JOIN BaseStats b ON bk.eqp_id = b.eqp_id 
ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: 3-sigma Z-Score on temperature per machine. Green ±2 (normal), Amber 2.5 (watch), Red 3+ (anomaly).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  "time",
  eqp_id AS metric,
  ROUND(
    (
      (temperature - AVG(temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY eqp_id)) / 
      NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY eqp_id), 0)
    )::NUMERIC, 2
  ) AS "Z-Score"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
  AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
  AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
  AND temperature IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "time" ASC;

panels.description: All matching ldi_alarm_log rows for the selected factory and machines. Every source column is shown, plus every joined master-code column and mapping status. Pagination is visual only; the SQL query has no row limit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.logid,
  a.logdate,
  a.errorcode,
  a.errortime,
  a.equipmentid,
  a.factory,
  a.process,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_id,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_type,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_code, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS alarm_code,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode :: TEXT) AS alarm_msg,
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record for this errorcode'
    ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail provided in master')
  END AS alarm_detail,
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED'
    ELSE 'MAPPED'
  END AS mapping_status
FROM
  public.ldi_alarm_log a
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode :: TEXT = m.alarm_code :: TEXT
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(a.logdate)
  AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY
  a.logdate DESC
